extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: six-wheeled Mars exploration rover, approx. 2.9 m long, 2.7 m wide, 2.2 m high (camera mast)
extras.notes: front faces -Y; 6 wheels are separate objects (mars-rover_wheel_*) with origin on the axle, roll around local X; rocker-bogie suspension, folded robotic arm, camera mast with emissive cyan status light; real inset panel seams, wheel tread grooves and cleats; no text, no flags, no agency logos

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
